title: Raymarched extruded SDF symbol
summary: A 2D signed-distance mark (ring + capsule, or a field baked from an SVG path) extruded with `min(max(w.x, w.y), 0) + length(max(w, 0)) − bevel` after shrinking profile and depth by the bevel, raymarched in raw WebGL2 inside a ray–box clip with an `80`-step budget; four-tap normals and AO, a studio ring environment so the bevel outshines the face, Schlick tint, inline ACES and gamma; depth-and-yaw intro then a slow sway on the shared ticker; an SVG stroke still under reduced motion, static, no WebGL2 or context loss
variants: raw WebGL2, analytic 2D SDF, one fullscreen triangle (this)
2D SDF baked at runtime from an SVG path into an R16F texture and sampled in mark()
three.js ShaderMaterial on a fullscreen triangle
